note: scip-python 0.6.8 resolves a name re-exported by a star import to another definition (pkg.Headers -> Response#, pkg.build -> Response#, as httpx.Response -> Request#). The oracle's symbol names something other than the token it sits on, so it gives no answer there (rule scip-name-mismatch). Controls: a correctly resolved re-export, an `import ... as` alias, a plain import.
